MathTrail

Tick the box for Google Drive

On Google's screen, the box that lets MathTrail keep its file in your Google Drive was left unticked. That one file is where your child's progress is saved, so MathTrail cannot work without it. It sees no other file in your Drive.

Press “Back to Google” and tick the box about your Google Drive files. Google words it in your account's language; in English it reads “See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app”.
